title: Parkettes

services.name: Classes
services.desc: Our sessions are 12 weeks and are based on the school year calendar (except for the Enrichment program which is month to month). Tuition is paid every 12 weeks. Tuition must be paid a month prior to start in order to guarantee your spot. A valid credit card or debit card is required for registration. All students are automatically enrolled in the same class for the next 12 weeks within the September-June year. Accounts will be billed one month prior to the start of each session. Due upon enrollment, and is effective September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. $35.00 per person, $20.00 each additional family member. prior to start class, the balance must be paid in full. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: -Designed to help gymnasts of all levels build confidence, learn new skills, and stay active in a supportive environment Campers jump right into fun skill stations and games designed to help them feel comfortable, make friends quickly, and discover that trying is more important than being perfect. Through balance challenges, strength games, and skill-building circuits, campers improve coordination, body control, and physical confidence. Partner drills and team challenges teach campers how to cooperate, encourage others, and feel part of something

services.name: Boys Gymnastics
services.desc: Parkettes’ Boys Gymnastics Program develops strong, confident, disciplined athletes through age-appropriate training on all six men’s Olympic gymnastics events. Boys learn power, agility, balance, body control, and coordination - all in a supportive environment built for progress and fun. Our boys program is ideal for beginners through advanced recreational athletes and provides a direct pathway into competitive men’s gymnastics for those who desire it.
